scope: same reviewed Atlas supplement installed into private server runtime before services

mechanism.server: MapServer/src/group/groupnetsend.c sends has_geo iff def->model is non-null, then its model name.
mechanism.client: Game/src/group/groupnetrecv.c receiveDef zeroes GroupDef and only getGeo assigns a model when has_geo is set.
mechanism.limitation: Source path plus staging mismatch support a cause hypothesis, not proof this run sent a particular missing model or that rendering is now fixed.

command_source:
import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path[:0]=['armport/scripts','tools','tools/android/game']
import server_atlas_data as server
import prepare_runtime as runtime
import prepare_game_data as game
root=Path('/tmp/coh-resume/server-atlas-copy-control');root.mkdir()
tools=root/'tools';tools.mkdir()
server.copy_inputs(Path('/tmp/coh-resume/atlas-supplement-input'),tools)
# Recreate the exact original assembler's directory spelling without pretending
# that this local structural control contains the unavailable full base assets.
plan=runtime.FilePlan()
for r in json.loads(Path('docs/data-manifest.json').read_text())['entries']:
 n=r['path']
 if n.startswith('data/') and runtime.excluded_reason(n[5:]) is None:plan.add(n[5:],Path(n))
for r in json.loads(Path('docs/source-manifest.json').read_text())['entries']:
 n=r['path']
 if n.startswith('data/server/db/') and Path(n).suffix.casefold()=='.cfg':plan.add(n[5:],Path(n),replace=True)
base=json.loads(Path('assets/reference-inputs-manifest.json').read_text())['files']
for r in base:
 if r['path'].casefold() not in plan.files:plan.add(r['path'],Path(r['path']))
data=root/'runtime/data';data.mkdir(parents=True)
for parent in plan.directories.values():(data/parent).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
manifest=tools/'atlas-world-supplement-manifest.json'
result=server.stage(tools/'atlas-supplement',data,manifest)
retained=json.loads((tools/'atlas-supplement/atlas-world-supplement-manifest.json').read_text())['files']
actual={p.relative_to(data).as_posix().casefold():p for p in data.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
for name,pin in retained.items():
 p=actual[name[5:].casefold()]
 assert not p.is_symlink() and p.stat().st_size==pin['bytes'] and hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()==pin['sha256']
expected=game.expected_data(Path('.'),base)
missing=[n for n in retained if n.casefold() not in expected]
assert len(missing)==len(retained)==2877
result.update(original_base_files=len(expected),original_base_bytes=sum(r['bytes'] for r in expected.values()),
 supplement_files_absent_from_base=len(missing),supplement_geometry_absent_from_base=sum(n.endswith('.geo') for n in missing),
 independently_rehashed_files=len(actual),base_directory_spelling_fixture=True,full_base_payload_present=False,
 server_execution_tested=False)
Path('/tmp/coh-resume/server-atlas-real-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
